detail.title: Riser 25 Metal Tablet Stand with 360° Rotating Base - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Riser 25 is a sturdy metal tablet stand built for tablets up to 7 inches, with a 360-degree rotating base that lets you switch between portrait and landscape orientation instantly for video calls, reading or watching content. Height and viewing angle are both adjustable, so you can dial in the exact position that suits a desk, kitchen counter or nightstand setup. A solid steel body gives it real stability compared to lightweight plastic stands, while anti-slip silicone pads at the base and cradle keep the tablet firmly in place without scratching the surface. A dependable, no-wobble stand for everyday tablet use around the home or office.
